async def act(page):
    # Fill the title textbox with the issue title
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Title').fill('Support for Llama and Llama Family Models')
    # Fill the description textbox with the issue details
    await page.get_by_role('textbox', name='Description').fill('Please provide information on your plan to support Llama and other models in the Llama family in metaseq.')
    # Click the button to create the issue; using the common name in GitLab
    await page.get_by_role('button', name='Create issue').click()
